reviewed_by: Codex focused Butler Voice cost-control review
reason: The Voice lifecycle, Core-wide timeout, Butler settings control, and assistant discovery changed. Fifteen focused Python cases cover transport, authenticated validation, revision and cross-project persistence, settings-tool discovery, and product-help synchronization. Fifty-six component cases cover Voice activity, mute, slow work, resume, background and close races plus the Butler settings interaction. Fifteen browser cases exercise the updated Voice journey at desktop and 320-430 px mobile Chromium/WebKit boundaries, saved-chat continuity, Core-wide settings persistence, and one opt-in real GPT-Live close receipt through disposable production HTTPS LAN Core.
exclusions: No native shell code changed, so no native test is selected. Existing unrelated settings, chat, storage and browser journeys are excluded despite shared API and catalog files; exact Voice and settings boundaries are selected instead. The real GPT-Live check is skipped in ordinary CI unless NEBULA_LIVE_VOICE_CHECK=1; mocked WebRTC alone is not proof of provider duration. Physical-device testing and full suites are excluded.
